rows.text: Ministry of Home Affairs notification No. 10/1/98-M&G of 6 April 1998, as first printed: the President has been pleased to accept the resignation of Shri I. K. Gujral of his office of Prime Minister and of the listed members of the Council of Ministers 'with effect from 19th March, 1998'.

locator.item: Notification No. 10/1/98-M&G, New Delhi, the 6th April, 1998 (first four lines)

rows.text: Notification No. 10/1/98-M&G(i) of 6 April 1998: the President has been pleased to appoint Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee to be the Prime Minister with effect from 0930 hours of 19 March 1998; the members of the Council of Ministers are appointed, on his advice, from the same time.

locator.item: Notification No. 10/1/98-M & G (i), New Delhi, the 6th April, 1998 (English on page 3; Hindi on page 2)

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only. The President's appointment, the oath or swearing-in, stated effective dates, confidence motions and votes, resignation announcements, letters and acceptances, requests to continue in office and attestations during a continuation stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Deputy prime ministers, ministers, the President and party offices are excluded.
